name: Yuuwaku Sangokushi Renka Sakerarenu Unmei
original_name: 誘惑三国志恋華 さけられぬ運命
source:
It all starts with the book you bought for an essay assignment; the book called ‘The Three Kingdoms’.

Guided by a mysterious bookmark left in the book, you slip back in time to the period of the three kingdoms! When you woke up, you saw the heroes of the three kingdoms right in front of you…!

There are lots of warriors who took part in the story of The Three Kingdoms; if you fall in love with these heroes, can you change their fate?

[From [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/tagged/android/page/7]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
这一切都始于你为论文作业购买的书；这本书叫《三个王国》。

在书中留下的神秘书签的引导下，你回到了三个王国时期！当你醒来时，你看到三个王国的英雄就在你的面前……！

参与三国故事的武士有很多；如果你爱上了这些英雄，你能改变他们的命运吗？

[来自[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/tagged/android/page/7]English Otome Games[/url]]
